correctness.rationale: For the positive-parameter semi-infinite chain with only boundary host mass perturbed, eliminating internal resonators away from w=k/m yields D(t)=t(M+k/(w-t))=K(2-lambda-lambda^-1). The free boundary gives lambda=K/(K+delta*t) and monotone secular F_delta(t). The signs of the decaying Bloch factor exhaust positive forbidden intervals, with one in (w,t0) for delta>0, none for delta=0, and optional upper/lower negative-lambda modes for delta<0 at thresholds -delta>2K/t_+, -delta>2K/t_-. Lambda=+-1 gives non-square-summable band edges; t=w is not an eigenvalue. Near each edge D-D_edge=+-K eta² and boundary matching eta linear in the threshold displacement, yielding quadratic mode births. The external finite-chain checker has not been rerun here; the infinite spectral claim is assessed analytically.
